RFC 8654 Section 5: "Similarly, any speaker that treats an improper BGP Extended Message as a fatal error MUST follow the error-handling procedures of [RFC4271]." RFC 4271 Section 6: "The phrase "the BGP connection is closed" means the TCP connection has been closed, the associated Adj-RIB-In has been cleared, and all resources for that BGP connection have been deallocated." "The local system recalculates its best routes for the destinations of the routes marked as invalid." "Before the invalid routes are deleted from the system, it advertises, to its peers, either withdraws for the routes marked as invalid, or the new best routes before the invalid routes are deleted from the system." Read every tagged carrier: message/header_test.go::TestValidateLengthWithMax, message/rfc8654_length_bounds_test.go::TestRFC8654LengthBoundsPerTypeAndCapability, reactor/rfc8654_bad_length_session_test.go::TestRFC8654OverLengthUpdateFollowsRFC4271ErrorHandling, reactor/rfc8654_fatal_length_cleanup_test.go::TestRFC8654FatalLengthReleasesInstalledRoutes and TestRFC8654ValidLengthRetainsInstalledRoutes, and reactor/rfc8654_rib_recovery_test.go::TestRFC8654FatalLengthReelectsAlternateBest (all under internal/component/bgp). Length 4097 with an all-ones marker and UPDATE type isolates the fatal-length boundary; the cleanup carrier asserts exact NOTIFICATION 1/2 Data 1001 followed by EOF, actual Adj-RIB-In/Loc-RIB removal, recipient withdrawals and resource release. The valid 4096 control waits for changed MED in actual storage and recipient TCP, then requires the original live session and resources with no notification or withdrawal. The owner-approved preferred-first replacement proof supersedes the stored alternate-already-installed note: the test first observes both preferred advertisements, installs the longer-AS_PATH alternate, waits for a contested adj-out entry still owned by the preferred source with no recovery owed, and requires all pre-failure route advertisements to carry the preferred AS_PATH and NEXT_HOP. After fatal failure it requires both alternate attributes together in every surviving-prefix replacement, forbids any withdrawal of that prefix, waits for both recovery outcomes and an empty owed set, then reads through a fresh native TCP marker. It asserts exactly one Loc-RIB ChangeUpdate, exact alternate stored attributes, withdrawal only of the prefix without a survivor, and both remaining sessions Established. Producer/consumer read: session_coalesce.go::readAndProcessCoalesced refuses length before body-read and fires EventBGPHeaderErr; reactor_notify.go::notifyPeerClosed delivers peer closure; plugins/rib/rib_bestchange.go::emitPurgedWithdraws re-elects before publishing replacement or withdrawal; reactor/relay_recovery.go::oweDeparture only owes entries owned by the departed source. The previous note saying no alternate re-advertisement is required is stale and must be replaced, not carried forward. Preserve the existing conformance scope: these carriers observe completed cleanup and replacement, not socket-delivery ordering against an unrelated plugin storage release or the lifetime of the last advertisement owner. Both readAndProcessMessage and readAndProcessCoalesced consume that gate before reading the body, send the error, fire EventBGPHeaderErr and close the socket. notifyPeerClosed invokes the registered closure observers. oweDeparture checks the destination session and uses departedOwner to exclude absent entries, another source and still-current ownership before creating recovery work.
